notes: Brazilian shared-services evidence confirms large service catalogs, KPI-driven operations and continuing automation interest. The simulated ranking opportunity was rejected because configurable rules, skills/capacity routing and current enterprise platforms already prioritize, assign and recommend resolutions. Advanced segment to human-resources and technical focus to causal-and-uplift-learning.
